title: Jira Cloud (REST v3 enhanced search, API token of a read-only account)
readScopes: Browse projects (project permission) on the projects the change, incident, security, review and deletion-request queries name

checks.title: Change records from the last 90 days carry an approval or reviewer
checks.scope: Issues the change JQL selects, created in the lookback window; changes made outside Jira are not visible.

checks.title: Incidents from the last 90 days were resolved within the SLA
checks.scope: Issues the incident JQL selects, created in the lookback window; time to resolve is resolutiondate minus created.

checks.title: No security issue stays open longer than the allowed age
checks.scope: Issues the security JQL selects whose status category is not Done; findings tracked outside Jira are not visible.

checks.title: Resolved incidents of the last 90 days each link a post-incident review issue
checks.scope: Resolved issues the incident JQL selects, created in the lookback window; a review counts when a linked issue has the configured type (--jira-review-issue-type).

checks.title: A disaster recovery test was resolved within the last 12 months
checks.scope: Issues the DR-test JQL selects; the test's scope and result are in the issue, not read.

checks.title: Log review tasks were resolved at the expected cadence over the last 90 days
checks.scope: Issues the log-review JQL selects; no gap longer than 1.5 times --jira-log-review-every-days (default 7).

checks.title: An access review was resolved within the last 90 days
checks.scope: Issues the access-review JQL selects; which accounts were reviewed is in the issue, not read.

checks.title: A security roadmap or investment review was resolved within the last 12 months
checks.scope: Issues the roadmap-review JQL selects; who took part, and what was decided, is in the issue, not read.

checks.title: Recovery time and recovery point objectives were reviewed within the last 12 months
Customer data deletion requests of the last 90 days were closed within the SLA
checks.scope: Issues the deletion JQL selects, created in the lookback window; time to close is resolutiondate minus created, against --jira-deletion-sla-days (default 30).

checks.title: A review of who can read log data was resolved within the last 90 days
checks.scope: Issues the log-access-review JQL selects; the access itself is not read.

checks.title: A review of the system's availability and recovery design was resolved within the last 12 months
checks.scope: Issues the availability-review JQL selects; the design itself is not read.
